vjce.canvas.select.tip: Shift+drag moves with alignment guides. Ctrl+click opens green transform handles: drag sides/corners to resize; Ctrl+corner preserves ratio. Alt+drag inside rotates; Shift snaps rotation to 15 degrees. Alt during a move/resize disables alignment. Click elsewhere to exit; Esc cancels a gesture. Outside transform mode Alt+click cycles overlaps. Drag empty space to pan.
vjce.native.texture.tip: Empty follows the source. Replacement must match the atlas size and UV layout.
vjce.native.component.tip: Source component: retains native drawing, data and animation.
vjce.native.fragment.tip: Generic drawing fragment: visual edits; native interaction needs a component adapter.
vjce.native.unstable: Unstable drawing identity: original display preserved; fragment edits are not applied.
vjce.scene.entity_hint: Entities stay anchored with AI and gravity disabled. Pose depends on the model. Edit equipment and variants under entities → data. Players and riding relations are not supported.
